input.quote: iii. Licensor hereby, subject to the terms and conditions of this Agreement and provided that Licensee makes payments to Licensor as required under this Agreement, grants to Licensee a non-exclusive license to utilize Licensed Technology solely in the Field of Use and subject to the additional restrictions set forth below and otherwise in this License Agreement.
input.rationale: The grant in p0030 runs to Licensee only, and the Field of Use definition (p0007) plus the restrictions in p0042 and p0045 limit use to Licensee's own employees, so Affiliates and contractors acting on our behalf are excluded with no path to add them. The licence is also effectively revocable: Article IV (p0049) lets Licensor terminate immediately "upon any breach" of any covenant with no materiality or cure period, and Article XX (p0134) auto-terminates the licence on a Change of Control absent consent, while the assignment clause (p0149) bars any transfer to a successor without consent. The redline extends the grant to Affiliates and contractors (with Licensee responsible for their compliance), makes the licence transferable to a successor in an M&A transaction, and limits revocation to an uncured material breach, reaching the preferred position with a single amendment to the grant paragraph.

proposal.summary: Extend licence to Licensee's Affiliates and contractors, make it transferable to a successor, and limit revocation to uncured material breach.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We extended the grant to our Affiliates and to contractors acting on our behalf (we remain responsible for their compliance), confirmed transferability to a successor in an M&A transaction, and limited Licensor's ability to revoke the licence to an uncured material breach. As drafted the licence is usable only by Licensee's own employees and can be terminated immediately for any breach or on a change of control, which is not workable for our operations; if helpful, we can accept Affiliate coverage on written notice as a fallback.
